messages:
mike (sales): Kevin is on the demo call, hitting 403s when calling /v1/chat. Customer is on hold, need quick triage.

tara (sales-eng): Hi Kevin, can you paste the exact curl and full error body? 403 usually means org/project header mismatch or scope issue.

kevin (customer): Error: {"error":"access_denied", "detail": "token bound to org-12"}. Using our CI runner to hit the hosted endpoint.

kevin (customer): curl -H "Authorization: Bearer SK.TMP.77" -H "X-Org-Id: org-34" -H "X-Project-Id: proj-9" https://api.redwood.ai/v1/chat -d '{"messages":[{"role":"user","content":"hi"}]}'

auth-bot: token-inspect: SK.TMP.77 -> bound_org: org-12, scopes: [chat,generate], created_via: sales-demo, expires_in: 86400s

chris (infra): The token is bound to org-12 but header says org-34. If the header is present and doesn't match binding we return 403. Also check X-Project-Id: if the project belongs to a different org that can trigger the same symptom.

tara (sales-eng): For the demo quick fix: remove X-Org-Id header so the key binding is used, or mint a short-lived key bound to org-34. Which is easier for you, Kevin?

kevin (customer): Removing X-Org-Id works. But for our CI we need an org-scoped token so we don't change headers. Can you mint one?

chris (infra): Creating a temp token bound to org-34 now. auth-bot: issue temp SK for org-34 scope=[chat,generate] expires=3600

auth-bot: issued: SK.TEMP.34 scope: [chat,generate] bound_org: org-34 expires_in: 3600s

kevin (customer): New token works, demo resumed. Thanks!

mike (sales): Quick pricing note while you're here: pricing-bot any rough hosted estimate for demo traffic (~1k tokens/min)?

pricing-bot: Estimated hosted cost for demo ~ $0.65 / hour at 1k tokens/min. See https://redwood.ai/pricing for details.

tara (sales-eng): Follow-ups: 1) Offer permanent token for org-34 if they proceed (mike to confirm), 2) add a short troubleshooting line to the POC checklist about X-Org/X-Project header mismatches, 3) consider returning bound_org (masked) in 403 payload to reduce back-and-forth (chris to log).

chris (infra): Filing INF-901: include bound_org hint in access_denied responses (mask sensitive ids). Also will add a docs snippet showing the curl mismatch example.

kevin (customer): I'll DM the security questionnaire now. Appreciate the fast support.

mike (sales): Great job team :thumbsup: Closing thread, will update CRM with key info and link to SOC2 artifacts.
